$comment: Read by tooling/ci/assert-lockfile-discipline.mjs limb 2b (rv2-security-020 / O-BRICK-PROBE-INSTALLS-WITHOUT-ITS-LOCK). A workflow install whose working directory does not exist in the tree is COVERAGE LOST (exit 2) unless it is declared here with the template it is stamped from; the install is then graded against that template's package-lock.json (present, tracked, in step with its package.json) and must be reproducible (npm ci). A declaration no install uses is stale, and COVERAGE LOST too.

dirs.why: The backend probe's Worker, stamped from the app brick seconds before its install and thrown away with the runner; mason substitutes only the package name in the lockfile, so the brick's lock is the one npm ci reads.
